integrity: The combinatorial minimizer is proved for every spider in the stated range, and the limiting weights are derived from the published inverse-weight tree curvature formula and the source convergence criterion. Finite enumeration in the bundled checker is used only as a stress test, not as a proof of the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes at least three subdivided arms.
It identifies the normalized metric limit but does not prove a convergence rate or an unnormalized-weight asymptotic.
It does not settle arbitrary finite trees or spiders with at most two subdivided arms.
title: Depth erasure and exact normalized Ricci-flow limits on subdivided spiders
